description: Metrics (JMAP_REQUESTS_TOTAL, JMAP_REQUEST_DURATION_SECONDS, EMAIL_QUERY_RESULTS) are recorded inside StoaHandler::call(), not at the Dispatcher level. This is correct — if moved to jmap-server Dispatcher it would require upstream changes to a shared crate. The per-method timing and Prometheus labels are preserved exactly. A contributor might suggest moving metrics into the Dispatcher; that would couple the generic server to stoa-specific metrics.
title: Per-method metrics preserved through adapter layer — correct design
